name: reasoning_depth_v1
_note: Reasoning-depth and transfer probes for procedural data, from tasksource eval_only annotations at pinned revisions (scripts/build_contrastive_evals.py, seed 43, --n 600 --max-prompt-chars 3600). Every row carries `depth` (KnowLogic level 1-3, BBH objects 3/5/7, ProverQA level 1-3 = 1-2/3-5/6-9 steps, CLUTRR hops 2-10, GSM-Infinite operations 2-30, SynthWorlds hops; None for MuSR, AGIEval, DivLogicEval, temporal_sequences) and `provenance` (human: AGIEval; templated: KnowLogic, BBH, CLUTRR, GSM-Infinite; llm: MuSR, DivLogicEval polished, ProverQA, SynthWorlds), so per-depth and templated-vs-human reads are a groupby. Multiple-choice legs score real option text with no menu in the prompt; proverqa and clutrr are closed-label legs (the label words are the options: read per-label accuracy, and hold out reasoning_core tasks of the same NLI/relation shape). gsm_infinite and synthworlds are qa_nll (gold answer likelihood, as gsm8k). synthworlds_real and synthworlds_synthetic share item ids (same graph, entities renamed): their gap is knowledge, not reasoning. BBH logical deduction drops items whose prompt states an option verbatim. MuSR keeps the items under 3600 characters (team allocation, part of object placements; no murder mysteries). Not included: Tales from a Graph and LogicTree (no public data), ParaRules (tasksource/ruletaker NatLang rows are the templated theories, not the paraphrases), Verbose ListOps (~10k-token narratives).
